_README: Tests that need something CI does not have: a local 40K/ROSIGMA mod install,
a private save file, or a command-line argument. Read by every runner's
tools/coop_test/run_parallel.py (when it discovers the suite itself; a test
named on its command line still runs). Unlike the quarantine list in
run_coop_suite.ps1, which still runs its tests, these are never discovered.
Run them by hand on a machine that has what they need. Without it they exit
non-zero with a 'needs ... at <path>' message, never a SKIP pass. The mod
folders default to ~/Documents/OpenXcom/mods/{40k,rosigma} and can be set

tests.test_separate_campaign_rosigma_saved_fin: 40K + ROSIGMA mods and a stage-2 save (ROSIGMA_FINALE_SAVE)
tests.test_separate_campaign_storage_owner_res: 40K + ROSIGMA mods and a 40K campaign save
